source: ranked lineups in data/aggregates/team-comps/1.18/ (games of ten minutes or more)
note: bands[key] = one rank band (rank the player held in that game; unplaced players only under all): minGames = games a hero + Eternal group needs there, playerRows = offlane / jungle / support player-games in the band. Per lane: board = groups whose win rate, pulled 100 games toward 50%, is 50% or better, ranked by soakPerDeath = (damage mitigated + hero damage taken) / deaths. deathsPer10 = deaths per ten minutes. otherEternals = the same hero and lane on every other Eternal. augment / crest / core / later = what the group's players run most (core = opening three in purchase order; later = items bought fourth to sixth, share of players who bought a fourth). laneAverage = every player in that lane and band. eternals = each Eternal against the same tank hero on every other Eternal, pooled over the lane's tank heroes: winDelta in points with its 95% margin, soakPct and deathsPct changes, verdict only when the whole margin is on one side of zero.
